_comment: OpenSpore cluster-first subsystem inventory. Counts are DB-grounded (triage table @ snapshot 2540f2ca, classifier triage-v2): every function_count/category/priority/sdk/decomp figure comes from a GROUP BY query, and cluster function_counts sum to 58757 exactly. sdk_namespace_total counts ALL sdk_functions.tsv addresses per namespace (incl. the ~1189 whose VA is not a function entry); sdk_coverage counts triage rows carrying sdk_name. Struct figures are second-level Spore/* components of structs.tsv (2035 rows). Vtable figures from vtables.json (3081 candidates / 300 pair-clusters / 12 chains / 306 sdk-associations). Stdlib only; no decompilation performed for this artifact.

rules_fix.note: rules-v1.json retained untouched for history; subsystem map carried over unchanged (FUN_ mass has no namespace signal, so subsystem refinement belongs at this cluster layer, not in the classifier).

evidence_base.decomp_note: Manifest reports 478 functions-at-SDK-address and 478 .c files, but only 477 triage rows carry sdk_name/decomp_path: one SDK VA (or one .c header VA) does not coincide with a functions.tsv entry. DB-grounded 477 used everywhere; 1-address gap is a named open item, not a closure break (58757/58757 rows classified).
evidence_base.kg_structure_note: KG holds 12 more Structure nodes than structs.tsv (hand-added analysis structures such as RW4Container/DBPFv3/GameModelResource).

clusters.name: utfwin-framework

major_vtables.note: Dominant vtable presence in the binary: 247/306 associations, 211/300 pairs. Inheritance chains rooted at 0x013fa974 (+21-slot base) are UTFWin hierarchies.

clusters.next_investigation: Highest P0 density (44). Start reconstruction with UTFWinObject new_/allocator + message-dispatch vtable roots; resolve the 5 IGNORE (thunk/external) vs 66 named split first.

clusters.name: app-lifecycle
clusters.next_investigation: Second-highest P0 count (58). Map App entry/boot sequence against sub:bootstrap-appsystem-lifecycle; 86 P3 are sdk+decomp without vtable (near-ready).

clusters.name: resource-io
clusters.next_investigation: Foundation for nearly every other cluster (DBPF/property/QFS groundwork exists in KG). Reconstruct ResourceKey/IO request paths; 4 of 4 KG substrate nodes already mapped.

clusters.name: sim-cell

major_vtables.note: No Cell vtable association in the 306; Cell virtuals (if any) hide inside unknown-vtable-impl.

clusters.next_investigation: Do NOT redo Cell work: reference the existing Cell investigation + 3 KG cell nodes. Gap is vtable linkage (P0=0 despite 26 decomped): probe unknown-vtable-impl slots for cCellGFX/cCellGame virtuals.

clusters.name: sim-space
clusters.display: Simulator Space stage (stars, planets, trading, terraforming)
clusters.sdk_namespace_note: Whole-Simulator SDK total; Space classes (~40 SDK fns: cStarManager 14, cSpaceTrading 8, cSolarSystem 6, cPlanetModel 7, cEmpire 3, cStar/cPlanet/cTerraformingManager)
clusters.next_investigation: Single P0 (IsNotStarOrBinaryStar) is the Space entry hook. cEmpire/cStar/cPlanet have SDK structs but thin triage rows: cross-check their VAs against unknown-vtable-impl.

clusters.name: sim-creature-tribeciv
clusters.sdk_namespace_note: Whole-Simulator SDK total; stage classes include cCreatureBase 15, cCreatureGameData 10, cCity 5, cCreatureAnimal 3
clusters.next_investigation: All P3 (sdk+decomp, no vtable): stage logic is decomped but unlinked. cCreatureBase (15 SDK fns, largely unmapped) + cCity are the priority vtable hunts in unknown-vtable-impl.

clusters.name: sim-core-systems
clusters.display: Simulator core (game data, modes, tools/weapons, missions, scenarios)
clusters.triage_slice: Simulator remainder after cell/space/creature slices (managers, cGame*, cTool*, cScenario*, cObjectPool_, cUIEventLog, cMissionManager, frame/time)

major_vtables.note: 5 P0 tool-strategy virtuals (cToolStrategy::OnSelect, cDefaultAoETool::OnMouseDown, cDefaultBeamTool::func4Ch, cGetOutOfUFOToolStrategy::OnSelect, cObjectPool_::DeleteObject)

clusters.next_investigation: Tool-strategy P0s are the gameplay interaction backbone: reconstruct cToolStrategy hierarchy first, then cGameModeManager/cGameData singletons (Get-pattern, GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT).

clusters.name: editor-core
clusters.next_investigation: 15 P0 cEditor virtuals (Undo/Redo/CommitEditHistory/PostEventToActors) anchor the editor command model. EditorAnim globals (GameGlobal spillover) belong here logically.

clusters.name: editor-support
clusters.next_investigation: cSkinnerTexturePainter (PaintRegion/StartRender/EndRender) bridges editor and renderer: reconstruct alongside graphics-render, not in isolation.

clusters.name: sporepedia-online

major_vtables.note: Second-strongest vtable signal after UTFWin; cSPAssetDataOTDB::HasName recurs in pair-clusters.

clusters.next_investigation: 9 P0 with rich vtable linkage: asset OTDB read paths first; online/Pollinator calls need no-network stubs from day one.

clusters.name: terrain-world
clusters.next_investigation: cTerrainSphere render trio (Land/Atmosphere/Decals) + Quad::Draw are all decomped: reconstruct as the graphics-render client. Simulator::cPlanetModel::ToSurface (sim-space) is the gameplay-side joint.

clusters.name: graphics-render

major_vtables.note: Zero SDK vtable associations: renderer virtuals are a prime unknown-vtable-impl hunting ground (BufferDraw ctor, SetRenderState live in gameglobal-misc).

clusters.next_investigation: Strongest KG asset-format coverage (5 nodes) but P0=0: renderer interface is decomped yet unlinkable. Joint probe with gameglobal-misc Renderer_SetRenderState/Graphics_BufferDraw__ctor.

clusters.name: ui-shell
clusters.next_investigation: Thin SDK slice (UI 13 total, 3 mapped); most UI behavior likely lives in UTFWin virtuals + unknown-vtable-impl. UI_EditorNamePanel_ctor (gameglobal-misc, P1) is the bridge exhibit.

clusters.name: scripting-content
clusters.next_investigation: 6 P0 script-VM functions: reconstruct the parse/eval loop early; it unlocks data-driven behavior for sim-* without binary patches.

clusters.name: swarm-anim
clusters.major_structs_note: Struct-heavy, function-thin: flocking/animation data layouts are known, call sites are not.
clusters.next_investigation: Function evidence is nearly absent (4 rows); treat as struct-first cluster. Hunt Swarm/Anim virtuals in unknown-vtable-impl via the 59+25 struct layouts.

clusters.name: audio-input
clusters.sdk_namespace_note: Audio 6 + GameInput 3 + Clock 4 + LocalizedString 2; Clock and LocalizedString have SDK entries but ZERO triage rows (their VAs are not function entries)
clusters.next_investigation: KG node name implies Havok, but no Havok namespace exists in SDK/structs/vtables: verify-or-drop the Havok hypothesis. Clock (4 SDK fns, 0 rows) needs Ghidra-side function-boundary repair before it exists at all.

clusters.name: gameglobal-misc

major_vtables.note: Single vtable member without SDK name: UI_EditorNamePanel_ctor (P1).

clusters.next_investigation: Logically belongs to editor-core (Editor_*), graphics-render (Renderer_SetRenderState, Graphics_BufferDraw__ctor, TexturePtr_Set) and sim (Simulator_Get*): re-home each row to its logical cluster on first touch rather than reconstructing 'GameGlobal' as a unit.

clusters.name: runtime-crt-stl
major_structs: CRT/Win headers (~140: PE, WinDef, winnt, winbase, excpt, ehdata, ...)
clusters.next_investigation: None (by design): replace with toolchain CRT + Eastl reimplementation. Only exception is the 2 Itanium-mangled game symbols (_ZN6EditorC2Ev et al.) misclassified by ^_Z: reclassify to editor-core in triage-v3 with demangling.

clusters.name: unknown-vtable-impl
clusters.display: Unnamed vtable members (FUN_ with SDK-less virtual slots)

major_vtables.note: By definition every row sits in >=1 vtable slot; 3081 candidates minus SDK-linked ones bound this pool. 300 pair-clusters + 12 inheritance chains are the map for carving it up.

clusters.next_investigation: HIGHEST-VALUE unknown pool: all 5758 are P1 virtuals one SDK-name attribution away from P0. Carve via the 300 pair-clusters (UTFWin/Sporepedia pairs already attributable) + 12 chains, then target Cell/Creature/renderer virtuals for sim-*/graphics-render.

clusters.name: unknown-fun-mass
clusters.next_investigation: 83% of the binary; do not attack directly. Shrink it with xref/call-graph signals (caller_count/callee_count are still NULL: no xref export exists yet) and by attributing unknown-vtable-impl first. Revisit only after both.

top_reconstruction_targets.why: 44 P0 + 247 vtable associations: the UI skeleton everything else hangs off.
5758 P1 virtuals; each SDK attribution mints a P0. Contains the missing Cell/Creature/renderer virtuals.
58 P0 boot paths; needed to run anything.
17 P0 persistence paths; foundation dependency of sim-*, editor-*, graphics-render.
5 P0 tool-strategy virtuals = the gameplay interaction backbone.
9 P0 + 59 vtable associations; self-contained asset-sharing vertical slice.
15 P0 editor command virtuals; second gameplay vertical after Cell.

open_items: 1-address sdk/decomp gap (478 manifest vs 477 DB rows): identify the orphan VA.
Clock (4 SDK fns) and LocalizedString (2) have zero triage rows: Ghidra function-boundary repair needed.
audio-havok-input KG node claims Havok with no SDK/struct/vtable corroboration: verify-or-drop.
2 Itanium-mangled game symbols misclassified THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME by ^_Z: demangle in triage-v3.
caller_count/callee_count NULL across all rows: no xref export exists; required before unknown-fun-mass can be carved.
GalaxyGameEntry (Space subsystem, 2 SDK fns) has zero triage rows and no cluster: assign on first Space investigation.
